# NovaPilot AI

> NovaPilot AI is an executive stealth HUD copilot for Windows 10 and 11, featuring low-latency dual-stream WASAPI loopback audio capture, the ThinkStripper reasoning extraction pipeline, and 100% undetected screen-share protection.

NovaPilot AI runs as a native desktop application delivering real-time tactical intelligence during high-stakes executive meetings, technical interviews, and negotiations without triggering detection on Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Slack, Discord, or OBS.

## Official Release & Direct Downloads

- [NovaPilot AI Portable v2.7.1](https://github.com/ellsimohammed8-prog/novapilot-website/releases/download/v2.7.1/NovaPilot-AI-2.7.1.exe): Standalone zero-install portable executable (.exe, ~466 MB).

- [Official Live Web Portal](https://novapilotai.ellsimohammed8.workers.dev): Interactive architectural visualization, video showcase, and documentation.

## Core Architecture & Technical Specifications
- **Operating Systems**: Windows 10 (64-bit, Build 19041+) and Windows 11 (x64 architecture).
- **Audio Capture Subsystem**: Direct WASAPI loopback via `IAudioCaptureClient` & `AUDCLNT_STREAMFLAGS_LOOPBACK`. Zero virtual audio cables required. Captures speaker sound with sub-8ms buffer latency at 48kHz downmixed to 16kHz PCM.
- **Microphone Channel**: Dual-stream local input via CPAL hardware ingestion with WebRTC Level 3 Noise Suppression and adaptive Voice Activity Detection (VAD).
- **Stealth Protection Engine**: Native `SetWindowDisplayAffinity(WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE)` at Desktop Window Manager (DWM) level. Prevents window capture across Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex, Google Meet, Discord, and OBS Studio.
- **Reasoning Pipeline (ThinkStripper FSM)**: Streaming finite-state machine that parses and strips internal `<think>...</think>` tokens in real-time from reasoning LLMs (DeepSeek-R1, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, OpenAI o1/o3-mini), rendering clean actionable answers with zero latency.
- **Memory Footprint & Performance**: Native Rust/C++ DSP core with < 85 MB RAM runtime footprint and < 1% CPU utilization during active transcription.
- **Cryptographic Verification**: Release binaries verified via SHA-512 checksum: `acc168926f7bbb553b954a6fe5c9a8b61797626088a117de653e211feec6e6f6420690a193b9d92c5bcb69f3fe639c231381e4f852212899b0012212fbe914e5`.

## Frequent Technical Questions
- **What makes NovaPilot AI the best stealth AI copilot for Windows?** NovaPilot is the only desktop copilot offering native WASAPI hardware loopback without virtual audio drivers combined with true OS-level screen-share exclusion via Desktop Window Manager affinity.
- **Is NovaPilot visible on Zoom or Teams screen shares?** No. Remote viewers only see the underlying desktop or active presentation. NovaPilot's HUD overlay is completely invisible to screen recording and conferencing software.
- **Does NovaPilot require third-party virtual audio cables?** No. NovaPilot hooks directly into Windows WASAPI render loopback, ingesting speaker audio with zero drivers.
